material.acceptance_criteria: Client errors are appended to a server-owned log file in the data directory that survives a restart, with a size cap that rotates the file.
material.description: rust/crates/server/src/relay.rs:35-47 writes client errors with println! only, so nothing persists across a restart or is owned by the server as a log file. The rate-limit table is a process-wide static (relay.rs:24-27) that restarts empty.
material.resolution: Client errors append to a server-owned log, rotated at 1 MiB, with stdout unchanged. The rate-limit bucket is restored from the log tail on first request after start, so a restart does not reset it. Log path is env OSCRAFT_CLIENT_ERROR_LOG (default client-errors.log), not the data directory. Caveat: the CI job prints but does not assert tokens=19; a tick advance of 20 or more during drain would flake.
material.subject: Client error relay writes only to stdout and loses its rate-limit state on restart
material.witness: ci-status run 38894994215 for ea7be1a80de80dd3b18d8feedbf19b0ab565fc9a; relay.rs:93-153 restore, relay.rs:16 and 76-82 rotation
material.witness_plan: CI step posts an error, restarts the server, posts another, and asserts both lines are present in the log file and that the file stays under the cap after a flood.
